# Kletterset

A gear kit without a picture, two traits, no reference. Invented for this
deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: troubleshooters
  card-type: gear
data:
  name: Kletterset
  content: 30 m Seil, Karabiner, Klettergurt, Kreide
  traits:
```
